final: SELECT order_averages.ordersmark, order_averages.timespan, order_averages.avg_fill, order_averages.avg_fill - tif_averages.tif_avg_fill AS above_tif_avg, order_averages.fill_rank FROM (SELECT order_fills.ordersmark, order_fills.timespan, order_fills.avg_fill, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_fills.timespan ORDER BY order_fills.avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank FROM (SELECT o.recordvault AS ordersmark, o.timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orders AS o JOIN orderexecutions AS e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.timespan) AS order_fills) AS order_averages JOIN (SELECT timespan, AVG(avg_fill) AS tif_avg_fill FROM (SELECT o.recordvault AS ordersmark, o.timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orders AS o JOIN orderexecutions AS e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.timespan) AS per_order GROUP BY timespan) AS tif_averages ON order_averages.timespan = tif_averages.timespan WHERE order_averages.avg_fill > tif_averages.tif_avg_fill AND order_averages.fill_rank <= 3
